plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says Thomas Kuhn, a famous thinker about how science changes, was friends with John Mack, head of the psychiatry department at Harvard University. According to Michels, Mack spent the later part of his career, in the 1990s, studying people who say aliens abducted them, with Kuhn's encouragement. If true, it means a respected scientist backed a Harvard psychiatrist in taking these accounts seriously.
